mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with temperatures at 74 degrees. We are looking at a new moon tonight, and the overnight low will be 68 degrees with no rain predicted.

Important updates for the city: the Plan Commission will meet on September 8 to discuss site plans, and please be aware that road construction on Highway M begins on August 18, involving utility work and lane shifts for the next few weeks.

We have a great lineup today including the Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus trivia.
During a notable call on Wednesday, August 5, officers located a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road who was wanted for a probation violation warrant and eventually taken into custody after a brief chase.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is open until 10 PM, so you have just under an hour to make it over there for a treat.
